data.narrative:
Arena AI is a Series B defense and security frontier-tech company founded by Pratap Ranade and Engin Ural that has raised $62M to date. The peer universe comprises 10 comparables—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in the same sector and stage. The private peer set includes Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns.

Two valuation methods were applied. The stage-progression method, using total capital raised as a proxy for current value, applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $118M. The peer-median method examines seven same-sector, same-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $300M to $3.0B. The median across this set is $1.0B, anchored by Dream Security at $3.0B and Defense Unicorns and Castelion both at $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $100M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $559M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty regarding Arena AI's relative competitive positioning and technology maturity within a fragmented peer set. The stage-progression method implies substantial upside from the capital raised baseline, while the peer-median method suggests significantly higher valuations are achievable in this sector at Series B. Key sensitivities include customer concentration, defensibility of proprietary capability, and regulatory environment shifts in defense tech.
